outline:
先修課程:4402025或負責教授同意
Introduce the characteristics of ground vehicle which may be described in terms of its performance, handling, and ride.  Performance characteristics refer to the ability of the vehicle to accelerate, to overcome obstacles, and to decelerate.  Handling qualities are concerned with the response of the vehicle to the driver's commands and its ability to stabilize its motion against external disturbances.  Ride characteristics are related to the vibration of the vehicle excited by surface irregularities and its effects on passengers and good.
